title_zh: 确认跨夜寄存费用并留下行李

scenario.label_zh: 办理酒店跨夜行李寄存
scenario.goal_zh: 核对跨夜寄存费用和次日领取期限，支付费用并取得领取凭据

context_zh: 退房旅客因第二天才继续旅行而询问酒店行李寄存。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Can my bag stay here overnight? I won't be back until tomorrow afternoon.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: Yes. Overnight storage costs six pounds, and you must collect it before six tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Do I owe you anything else from my room bill?

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: No, that's settled. This is just the storage charge.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: I'll pay that now. I'll collect the bag around four.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: Here's your claim ticket. Keep it safe; otherwise, we'll need extra checks before we can release the bag.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Thank you. I've put it in my wallet.
